description: Read guest messages (Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, email, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app) for a lead, a thread or a whole agency, with sender type, status and content. Give lead_uid, thread_uid, or agency_uid (or the default). Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/messages.

agency_uid.description: Agency UID. Defaults to HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_UID; hostfully_list_agencies lists the options.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's _paging._nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

name: hostfully_list_messages
title: List messages
